set.body:
Outcome: detail-level recall-to-film mapping in the same bundle: DL1 recall detail inventory, DL2 source cast and row record, DL3 graded binding, DL4 derived coverage, DL5 unit-only mapping and order-readout qualification, and DL6 who-did-what. Core detail structure remains reusable; internal/external categories are derived under a named scoring policy, not primitive kinds or fidelity judgments.
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md. DL1, DL3, DL4 and DL6 have fresh-item exits; DL2 has an engineering spot-check/coverage exit; DL5 has an engineering claim-boundary decision. Thresholds remain proposed. Claim children, not this container.
The roadmap phase finish line currently requires DL1/DL3/DL4 fresh exits, DL2 engineering exit and the DL5 decision. DL6 remains an explicit child; its phase-finish and joint validation placement need an owner decision. Film representation is mandatory. Do not infer that the owner has approved dropping the full event-graph commitment: its delivery sequence is under discussion.
